first.rationale: Onboarding deterioration is directly aligned with prior durable evidence that shorter flows improve completion, time-to-value, and adoption. This may also help recover activation without introducing discount-driven customer-quality risk. Verify promotional pricing as the strongest alternative given competitor pressure, with particular attention to retention and qualified revenue.

final.rationale: Run a controlled experiment shortening onboarding. The confirmed prior test improved completion by 13%, reduced time-to-value by 2.1 days, and increased 30-day retention by 3%, directly addressing both current declines while supporting sustainable qualified revenue. Reject promotional pricing despite competitive pressure: its 18% qualified-revenue lift was offset by 12% lower 30-day retention and failure through first renewal.
